vw_schemes.description: Monthly pension support of ₹3,000 for elderly village citizens to ensure financial dignity.
vw_schemes.eligibility_criteria: Age 60 years or above, categorized as Senior Citizen.
vw_schemes.apply_instructions: Submit age proof, residence certificate, and Aadhaar card at the local Sachivalayam.

vw_schemes.description: Financial assistance to students from low-income families pursuing higher education.
vw_schemes.eligibility_criteria: Age 25 years or below, categorized as Student, studying in recognized institutes.
vw_schemes.benefits: 100% tuition fee reimbursement + ₹10,000 yearly hostel allowance.
vw_schemes.apply_instructions: Apply online on the scholarship portal. Upload income certificate, caste certificate, and mark sheets.

vw_schemes.description: Financial assistance and input subsidies for farmers to purchase seeds, fertilizers, and equipment.
vw_schemes.eligibility_criteria: Categorized as Farmer, owning agricultural land in the village boundary.
vw_schemes.apply_instructions: Register land records (Pattadar Passbook) with the Village Agriculture Assistant (VAA).

vw_schemes.description: Welfare pension program to support widows and single women living in rural areas.
vw_schemes.eligibility_criteria: Female gender, categorized as Widow, age 18 years or above.
vw_schemes.benefits: ₹3,000 monthly pension and health insurance coverage.
vw_schemes.apply_instructions: Submit husband's death certificate, self-declaration form, and bank account statement at the Sachivalayam.

vw_schemes.description: Universal health insurance cover for lower and middle-income families for tertiary care treatment.
vw_schemes.eligibility_criteria: Open to all categories, rural household index card holders.
vw_schemes.benefits: Free cashless inpatient healthcare up to ₹5 Lakhs per year in network hospitals.
vw_schemes.apply_instructions: Get the Aarogyasri card generated through the local Volunteer. Bring ration card and Aadhaar card.

vw_schemes.description: Technical and vocational training program for rural youth to build employability skills.
vw_schemes.eligibility_criteria: Age between 18 and 35 years. Categorized as Student or General.
vw_schemes.benefits: 3-month certified training in IT, Retail, or Electronics, including free lodging and placements.
vw_schemes.apply_instructions: Fill up the Skill Registry form. Volunteer verification required.

vw_schemes.description: Financial support for constructing permanent (pucca) houses for homeless rural families.
vw_schemes.eligibility_criteria: Low-income family. Categorized as Senior Citizen, Widow, Farmer, Disabled, or General.
vw_schemes.benefits: ₹1.80 Lakhs subsidy for house construction in 4 stages.
vw_schemes.apply_instructions: Apply through your ward volunteer. Land ownership document (patta) must be submitted.

vw_schemes.description: Pension and assistance for citizens with physical disabilities to enable self-reliance.
vw_schemes.eligibility_criteria: Minimum 40% disability certified by SADAREM. Categorized as Disabled.
vw_schemes.benefits: ₹3,000 monthly pension and free assistive aids (wheelchairs, hearing aids).
vw_schemes.apply_instructions: Provide SADAREM disability certificate, Aadhaar card, and photo showing disability.

vw_schemes.description: Distribution of subsidized essential commodities (rice, wheat, sugar, oil, pulses) to village households.
vw_schemes.eligibility_criteria: Open to all categories, subject to economic verification status.
vw_schemes.benefits: Subsidized food grains: Rice at ₹1/kg, sugar at ₹13.50/kg, wheat at ₹2/kg.
vw_schemes.apply_instructions: Apply online for a new Ration Card or link Aadhaar with existing cards through the Volunteer.

vw_schemes.description: Subsidy on buying tractors, seed drills, harvesters, and irrigation pumps.
vw_schemes.eligibility_criteria: Categorized as Farmer, possessing a valid Rythu Bharosa Card.
vw_schemes.benefits: 40% to 50% subsidy on purchases of modern farm implements.
vw_schemes.apply_instructions: Submit quotation of equipment, land passbook, and bank details on the Rythu Seva portal.

vw_notifications.message: Your monthly Old Age Pension benefit of ₹3,000 for the month of June 2026 has been successfully credited directly to your registered bank account (Aadhaar linked state bank).

vw_notifications.title: 🎓 Student Scholarship Deadline approaching
vw_notifications.message: Students registered for the Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme are reminded that the application window closes on June 30, 2026. Please complete your registration and submit documents to the volunteer immediately.

vw_notifications.title: 🪪 Income Certificate Renewal Due
vw_notifications.message: Your Income Certificate is expiring on June 25, 2026. Please apply for a fresh income certificate immediately to avoid disruptions in active welfare benefits.
